catalyst.description: The company launches its next-gen data-center GPU

article.headline: Acme says next-gen accelerator on track to launch next quarter
article.summary: Acme said its next flagship data-center accelerator remains on track to launch next quarter. The chip has not yet shipped, and pricing was not disclosed.

catalyst.description: The company completes its acquisition of Nimbus

article.headline: Bidco expects Nimbus deal to close by year-end
article.summary: Bidco said it expects its acquisition of Nimbus to close by the end of the year, pending regulatory clearance. The transaction has not yet completed.

catalyst.description: The FDA approves the company's lead drug

article.headline: Biox drug accepted for FDA review, decision expected in H2
article.summary: The FDA accepted Biox's marketing application for review, with a decision expected in the second half of the year. No approval decision has been issued.

catalyst.description: The company initiates its first dividend

article.headline: Cashco CFO says a first dividend is under consideration
article.summary: Cashco's finance chief said the board is considering initiating a dividend and will update investors next quarter. No dividend has been declared.

catalyst.description: The company wins the Air Force fighter contract

article.headline: Defco viewed as frontrunner as Air Force weighs bids
article.summary: The Air Force is still evaluating bids for the fighter program, with an award expected in the coming months. Analysts consider Defco a frontrunner, but no contract has been awarded.

catalyst.description: The company completes its acquisition of Halo

article.headline: Orbit to acquire Halo in all-cash deal

catalyst.description: The company confirms a partnership with a hyperscaler

article.headline: Vertex said to be nearing cloud partnership, insiders say
Sources: Nova in advanced talks to buy Quill, deal could land within weeks
article.summary: People familiar with the matter said Nova is in advanced talks to acquire Quill and an agreement could be announced within weeks. Neither company has commented and no deal has been signed.

article.headline: Regulator opens in-depth probe of Stellar merger over competition concerns
article.summary: The competition regulator opened an in-depth review of Stellar's proposed merger, citing concerns about market concentration. No approval has been granted.

catalyst.description: The company announces a new share buyback

article.headline: Momentum posts record revenue and lifts full-year guidance
article.summary: Momentum reported record quarterly revenue and raised its full-year guidance, citing strong demand. The release did not mention any change to its capital-return program.

catalyst.description: The company acquires an AI model developer

article.headline: Gale takes minority stake in AI startup Lumen
article.summary: Gale said it made a minority investment in AI startup Lumen and will collaborate on models. Gale is not acquiring Lumen and will hold no board seat.

catalyst.description: The company launches its new headset

article.headline: Pixel teases new headset at developer conference
article.summary: At its developer conference, Pixel showed a prototype of an upcoming headset and discussed its ambitions in the category. The company did not announce a release date or begin sales.

catalyst.description: The company completes its acquisition of Nimbus

article.headline: Bidco completes acquisition of Nimbus
article.summary: Bidco said today it has completed its acquisition of Nimbus, which is now a wholly owned subsidiary. The deal closed after receiving all required approvals.

catalyst.description: The FDA approves the company's lead drug

article.headline: FDA approves Biox's lead drug
article.summary: The FDA today approved Biox's lead drug for the treatment, the company said. Biox said it would make the product available immediately.

catalyst.description: The company announces a new share buyback

article.headline: Cashco authorizes $10 billion buyback
article.summary: Cashco's board authorized a new $10 billion share repurchase program, effective immediately, the company said in its results.

catalyst.description: The company launches its next-gen data-center GPU

article.headline: Acme begins shipping its next-gen accelerator
article.summary: Acme said today it has begun shipping its next-generation data-center accelerator to customers, with general availability effective now.

catalyst.description: The company wins the Air Force fighter contract

article.headline: Air Force awards Defco the fighter contract
article.summary: The Air Force announced it has awarded Defco the contract to build its next-generation fighter, ending the competition.

article.headline: Regulator clears Stellar merger
article.summary: The competition regulator said it has cleared Stellar's merger unconditionally, allowing the deal to proceed. The companies said they would complete the transaction shortly.
